concerns.text: Task T045 [P] implements the top‑level CLI that sequentially calls the topology extractor, VDOS calculator, κ‑ingester, and statistical analyzer. It appears in Phase 1, before the services it invokes (e.g., T017, T063, T041) are defined. This creates a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation; T045 should be scheduled after the implementation of those dependent services.

Task T049 [P] computes SHA‑256 hashes of every file under `data/`, `src/`, and `outputs/`. It is listed early in Phase 1, before the majority of data and code artifacts are generated (e.g., topology CSVs, VDOS outputs, correlation JSONs). Running it prior to artifact creation yields incomplete hashes. T049 should be moved to a later phase (e.g., after Phase 6 reporting) to ensure all produced files are included.
